services.name: Triple-decker porch rebuilds
services.blurb: Front or back porch stacks rebuilt floor by floor: posts, decking, rails and roof trim.

services.name: Porch railings and balusters
services.blurb: Wobbly rails replaced at typical 36-inch guard height with balusters spaced under 4 inches.

services.name: Back stairs and egress stairs
services.blurb: Rotted rear stairs rebuilt with solid stringers, even risers and a rail you can grip.

services.name: Porch floors and posts
services.blurb: Soft porch boards and rotted post bases swapped out before they become a hazard.

services.name: Clapboard and exterior trim
services.blurb: Split clapboards, corner boards and rotted window trim replaced and primed before winter.

services.name: Decks and back steps
services.blurb: Small backyard decks and steps built on proper footings, sized for a grill and chairs.

services.name: Apartment turnover carpentry
services.blurb: Doors, trim, closet shelves and stair treads fixed between tenants so the unit rents faster.

services.name: Doors that stick or won't lock
services.blurb: Front and unit doors planed, rehung and lined up so the locks catch every time.

services.name: Sheds, pergolas and fences
services.blurb: Garden sheds, pergolas and short fences framed in pressure-treated wood and cedar.

services.name: Sills, joists and framing
services.blurb: Rotted porch ledgers and sagging joists sistered or replaced so the floors sit level again.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I own a triple-decker on Grafton Hill and the back porches were failing on all three floors. Nico's crew rebuilt them one floor at a time so my tenants always had a way down the back. Done before the October rain.
reviews.name: Fatima R.

reviews.text: Second-floor railing moved when you leaned on it. They replaced the whole run, and my inspector checked the height and the baluster gaps without a single note.
reviews.name: Kevin D.

reviews.text: Back stairs had one tread that cracked in February. They came out, shored it up so we could use it, and rebuilt the full stair in April when the ground thawed.
reviews.name: Ana P.

reviews.text: We live on the first floor and rent the other two. Turnover in June used to mean a month of calls. This year they handled doors, trim and a closet in four days and texted photos of every fix.
reviews.name: Joe M.

reviews.text: Corner boards on our Holden colonial were rotting at the bottom. Replaced, primed, and they pointed out two more spots to watch next year instead of padding the bill.
reviews.name: Bridget O.

reviews.text: Porch floor on Vernon Hill was soft near the steps. Two days later it was new fir boards, painted gray, and the posts were sitting on new bases. My kids sit out there every night now.
reviews.name: Luis C.

proof.guarantee: If a porch, rail or stair we built loosens or rots within 5 years, we come back and make it right.
